vault.about: Vault is a mobile banking app built around four everyday tasks: real-time balance, spending-limit tracking, quick transfers, and monthly budget trends. The client requested to solve user drop-off in core banking flows and build trust with busy professionals and first-time digital banking users.
vault.problem: Competitors’ financial apps have a long control panel with charts, limit indicators, transaction lists, and promotional offers. They force users to scroll through more than six tabs of metrics before finding their balance. Completing a money transfer required 5–8 taps. User reviews of the app, along with our own testing, confirmed users’ frustration with this cluttered interface. The issues we identified included slower app adoption, lower trust levels, and higher user churn.
vault.solution: RZQ split Vault into a focused Home view with the main data and a separate Statistics view for income or spending trends. This sequencing, refined after testing, showed users misread combined metrics, cut scanning fatigue, and reduced transfer steps for repeat recipients. Fewer screens meant fewer reload risks on unstable connections and faster core-task completion.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: Our team adopted the "one screen, one thought" philosophy. We separated login, recipient selection, money entry, and confirmation into individual screens rather than one long merged form. Our technology decreases the danger of reloading due to bad connections and input errors for first-time digital banking users. Early wireframes stacked three cards on the dashboard, but consumers misinterpreted the combined balance/spending view, so we simplified it to a single dominating balance and shifted trends to Statistics.

sections.title: Facing drop-off in your core user flows? RZQ will find where and fix it.
UI Layouts
sections.text: On the main control panel, the balance and main actions (Request, Transfer) appear in the top third of the screen so they can be reached with a thumb. The “Quick Send” icons show up right below them, allowing users to skip the usual recipient search. Our team used “royal blue” for key actions and positive data in combination with a dark interface to reduce eye strain and improve the readability of charts on the five main screens and 6–7 sub-screens. To ensure accessibility, we adhered to WCAG AA requirements for contrast ratios and created large touch elements.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: During our collaboration, the client asked our brand team to expand the design system into a marketing environment. The "Simple. Secure. Smart." tagline is consistent throughout Vault's marketing assets, including app stores and social media posts. Instead of lengthy feature lists, we created a focused set of stories and banners anchored by user-centric testimonials regarding rapid, reliable transfers.

results.title: Transfer task completion
results.text: Most users completed the send-money flow without assistance during usability testing.

results.title: Design duration
results.text: RZQ scoped and completed the project in a tight two-month timeframe.

results.title: Send Money flow
results.text: Reduced from the 5–6 taps typical of comparable banking apps to select recipient, enter amount, confirm.

results.title: Fewer flow errors
results.text: Separating recipient selection, amount entry, and confirmation helped to eliminate input and navigation errors during testing.

altis.headline: Pitch Deck for a Cybersecurity Platform
altis.lead: Complex security explained with visual clarity
altis.about: Altis helps companies detect threats and respond faster through AI automation. The team came to RZQ for a sharper brand identity and pitch deck that could explain their security value without heavy cyber clichés.
altis.problem: Security decks use low-light interfaces and visual stress to increase an impression of approaching risk. Altis had to explain AI-based threat detection without the usual overcomplicated style. We aimed for a more tranquil visual style that could clearly express the product's logic.
altis.solution: Filling every screen with data is not necessary for a credible security design. Our team cut the visually packed interface down to its essential statements. We were able to maintain a technically sound look and clear product rationale by splitting metrics into smaller components.

sections.title: Style
sections.text: The design strikes a mix between obvious security messages and more subtle visual clues. Strict grid lines, dark backgrounds, and rock textures all work together to provide a realistic sense of security. To avoid a cold, digital aesthetic, the brand uses dotted AI patterns and pale yellow gradients to soften that base. In the same vein, the logo is simple to apply all over the deck, has a small footprint, and is sharp.

sections.title: Pitch Deck
sections.text: The pitch deck relies on large-scale screens, high contrast, focused content blocks, and a single consistent visual style. Altis is able to convey technical value without overwhelming the viewer with visual noise since each slide focuses on a single essential topic, such as audience demands, performance, or data flow.

sections.title: Your product may be complex. Your pitch deck should make it easy to believe in.
Printing materials
sections.text: Printed materials gave Altis more credibility in offline sales and investor settings. Every cybersecurity touchpoint needs to signal trust quickly, without relying on dense technical detail. We kept the layouts clean, outcome-focused, and visually connected to the deck, so the brand could feel serious at events, meetings, and presentations.

results.title: Deck Read-Through Rate
results.text: When going from AI danger detection to response logic, structured storytelling kept people interested without losing them in the more technical security slides.

results.title: Product Explanation Time
results.text: The team was able to explain automation, visibility, and incident response more quickly during stakeholder conversations by using a focused slide hierarchy.

results.title: Qualified Follow-Up Requests
results.text: Clearer positioning and a more premium cyber identity helped Altis attract better-fit investor and B2B conversations after review.

results.title: Brand Recall After Review
results.text: The dark base, yellow focus cues, and minimal logo system made Altis easier to recognize after pitch reviews and event touchpoints.

aethel-finance.headline: Pitch Deck Design for a Fintech Infrastructure Platform
aethel-finance.lead: Design a story investors can understand in seconds
aethel-finance.about: Aethel Finance is a fintech company that builds digital banking and payment products on complex financial infrastructure. The company needed a pitch deck that could carry its business case to investors on its own, without relying on a walkthrough to fill the gaps.
aethel-finance.problem: Aethel Finance's original deck gave that detail equal visual priority alongside product features and business strategy on every slide. With no clear hierarchy, investors had to work out which claim mattered most. And that work cost the deck its strongest window because investors decide whether a product is worth their attention in the first few slides.
aethel-finance.solution: Our team recreated the deck with one crucial message each slide. We pared down the text to only the most compelling arguments and deleted anything that contradicted them. Product pictures are shown next to the statements they support, allowing investors to verify each statement promptly.

sections.title: Style
sections.text: The presentation has a restrained visual language, with contrast, depth, and whitespace. Dark backgrounds carry the narrative frame and keep focus on one message per slide. A soft teal gradient render adds movement without competing with the financial data around it. Product cards sit inside generous white space, so each number reads as evidence. Large-scale renders and clean typography slow the pace between data-heavy slides, so investors have a visual pause before the next slide.

sections.title: We organize high-stakes information so the right claim surfaces first and moves the pitch forward .
Pitch Deck
sections.text: We reduced each slide to one clear message and placed interface visuals beside the claims they prove, so investors could verify each statement instantly. This cuts the time it took investors to grasp Aethel Finance's core argument and keeps their attention through the slides. A deck is faster to read and builds credibility through structure as much as design.

sections.title: Printing materials
sections.text: Beyond the pitch deck, our brand team also delivers printed materials. Business cards, one-pagers, and leave-behinds keep the pitch alive after the meeting ends. A consistent identity across formats helps protect the pitch from dilution elsewhere. Aethel Finance welcomed the addition. The printed pieces carry over the deck's gradient, geometric forms, and typography. They keep the brand recognizable long after the room empties.

results.title: Less Content Per Slide
results.text: The redesigned deck reduced on-slide information so each slide carried one core argument instead of several competing messages.

results.title: Branded Pitch Formats
results.text: The visual system was extended across the investor deck, one-pagers, and printed leave-behinds for a consistent pitch experience.

results.title: Faster Core Argument Recognition
results.text: Testing showed that viewers understood Aethel Finance’s main business proposition faster after the deck was restructured.

results.title: Narrative Clarity
results.text: Users followed the investment story from problem to product and business case without needing additional explanation.

stockgate.headline: Fintech Branding for a Crypto Investment Platform
stockgate.lead: A human-centered brand identity for trust and conversion
stockgate.about: StockGate is a crypto investment platform that combines portfolio management, crypto exchange, and financial insights to help investors at every experience level manage digital assets. The client needed to launch with a brand that could compete on perception and support user confidence.
stockgate.problem: Without a distinct visual identity, StockGate risked becoming just one of dozens of crypto platforms that look reliable enough to be simply ignored. Our RZQ team needed to create a branding system that would reduce the risk of user churn by clearly demonstrating the platform’s reliability. Our design solutions had to convey security, transparency, and financial confidence.
stockgate.solution: Our brand designer created a visual system that combines photographs of people, bold minimalism, and a palette of orange, blue, and black. This sets the platform apart from competitors, who tend to use cold and technical interfaces. The brand identity mitigates negative first impressions and gives the platform a trustworthy, recognizable identity that helps increase conversion rates.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: The StockGate logo has two offset geometric forms that lock together to suggest simultaneous movement and stability. It communicates the core promise of a crypto investment platform that keeps assets in motion and maintains structural control. The mark is readable at app icon scale without relying on fine detail or color. The full identity system holds in monochrome and across reversed backgrounds to scale consistently across product, marketing, and third-party placements.

sections.title: We replace cold crypto aesthetics with a human-centered brand system to increase trust and conversion.
Printing materials
sections.text: We extended the brand system across outdoor advertising, business cards, and branded merchandise. That cross-surface consistency supports StockGate's business goal of building institutional credibility. A brand that shows up with the same visual confidence offline as it does in the product is one that investors are more likely to trust before they open the app.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: Our design goal was to stop a user in mid-scroll. We blend headline typography, human photos, and 3D brand elements to create a consistent visual structure that is instantly recognized across placements. Each banner helps StockGate reach its user acquisition objective by converting paid and organic social traffic into platform sign-ups.

results.title: Sign-Up Intent
results.text: After seeing the branded landing, social assets, and offline materials, users were more likely to consider creating an account compared to competitors.

results.title: Clear Brand Differentiation
results.text: Users were able to distinguish StockGate from typical crypto platforms thanks to its warmer visual direction and human-centered design system.

results.title: Confidence in the Platform
results.text: Most tested users said the human-centered visuals, clear brand structure, and confident color system made the platform feel safer to explore.

results.title: Perceived as More Professional
results.text: Users rated the identity as more mature, credible, and investment-ready than competitors' common crypto brand visuals.

lumera.headline: UI/UX Design for a Mental Wellness Platform
lumera.lead: Created for people overwhelmed by digital noise
lumera.about: Lumera is an AI-powered mental wellness platform designed for people overwhelmed by constant noise. In order to assist people in slowing down and gaining insight into their emotional patterns, RZQ developed a soothing UI/UX design based on guided reflection.
lumera.problem: As a result of their users' chronic information overload, Lumera needed to find a way to transform complicated AI mood analytics into a relaxing UX journey. Keeping each insight clear without transforming reflection into another crowded dashboard was the challenging part.
lumera.solution: We distilled mood analytics to a simple editorial UI and purposefully eliminated traditional dashboard designs. Users are able to narrow their attention to a particular topic at a time, which promotes more thoughtful reflection and less information overload.
lumera.processIntro: We started with users’ emotional state flows instead of traditional wireframes. First, our designers sketched out important times of reflection, and then they created the interface components around those.

sections.title: Moodboard
sections.text: Our designers went beyond the usual design clichés for meditation apps. To achieve a more realistic and high-end aesthetic, the moodboard blended urban settings with muted colors and rich textures.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: The "one screen, one thought" principle was the foundation around which our designers developed the wireframes. On desktop and mobile, the large content areas and generous spacing helped support a slower reading flow, and each layout focused attention on one primary idea at a time.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: The geometric logo that our designers made for Lumera represents the company's mission to simplify complexity. The use of rounded shapes in branding helps make the productseem more relatable and friendly.

sections.title: Create products people return to without relying on dark patterns .
Mobile Adaptation
sections.text: There wasn't much space for Lumera's relaxing pace on mobile screens. With just one central idea and enough space surrounding it, our designers avoided making the layout too cluttered with stacked feature blocks.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: Social media posed a different challenge. The Lumera website promotes a peaceful pace, in contrast to the social media platforms that value speed and continual stimulation. Our team kept the layouts simple so that the typography, images, and reflective questions could carry the message on their own.

results.title: TRIAL SIGNUPS
results.text: Clearer product storytelling encouraged more visitors to start Lumera’s free trial.

results.title: CTA CLICK RATE
results.text: Focused content blocks guided users toward key actions with less decision friction.

results.title: BOUNCE RATE
results.text: A calmer visual rhythm kept visitors engaged beyond the first website sections.

results.title: FEATURE DISCOVERY RATE
results.text: A clearer page flow helped users notice and explore more of Lumera’s core tools.

healium.headline: Website Design for a Digital Pharmacy
healium.lead: Design that reduces friction and builds patient trust
healium.about: Healium is a digital pharmacy that lets users browse a curated medication catalog, upload prescriptions for AI-assisted verification, and arrange delivery. RZQ designed Healium's brand identity and website to shift the platform's public perception away from the clinical look.
healium.problem: Healium required a website that could provide customers with the medical credibility they need when making prescription decisions, as well as the warmth of a brand that does not make healthcare feel intimidating. The website needed to express functional complexity without making it apparent in the UI or visual language.
healium.solution: RZQ developed a visual identity and website based on the concept of combining nature and health. We replaced pharmaceutical cliches with botanical textures, natural hues, organic shapes, and soft gradients, giving the brand a wellness-oriented character. Complex information flows have a simple structure. Navigation is intuitive, while still revealing the platform’s depth.

sections.title: Moodboard
sections.text: Our team rejected standard pharmaceutical references of sterile lab environments, cold lighting, and generic medical imagery. We found inspiration in wellness aesthetics, editorial minimalism, and nature photography because this direction communicates healing and reassurance through visual atmosphere. Our goal was to make a distinctive brand foundation in the pharmacy space. Calm. Curative. Fresh.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: The wireframes had to reduce cognitive load at every step of the healthcare journey. We avoided instructional copy that compensates for unclear layout decisions. Each screen gives users a visible next step, so the experience is guided. And the user can figure everything out independently.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: The Healium logo features an abstract mark composed of three rounded, petal-like shapes arranged in a circular formation. This form reads as a botanical element and a stylized medical cross, connecting the brand's two core territories of nature and healthcare. The mark carries enough visual simplicity to hold across small touchpoints. The earthy green palette reinforces the nature-meets-pharmacy direction without borrowing the cold blues and whites that dominate most pharmaceutical identities.

sections.title: Our healthcare design reduces anxiety, feels human, and increases conversion.
Mobile Adaptation
sections.text: Our team prioritizes the prescription upload process and the product catalog above all else. These are the two interactions that most frequently occur on a mobile phone. Full-width images, large clickable elements, and a single-column layout ensure high-quality visual presentation even on small screens. Information about medications remains clear and reliable even on a 6-inch display.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: We built a social media system around the same nature-inspired palette and editorial photography style as the website. So, the brand reads consistently across every touchpoint a potential customer encounters before visiting the site. The content direction balances healthcare information with lifestyle aesthetics to avoid the clinical tone that causes healthcare content to underperform on social platforms.

results.title: Faster Service Understanding
results.text: Users understood how Healium works 42% faster than on comparable digital pharmacy websites, where key service information was spread across multiple sections.

results.title: Fewer Navigation Errors
results.text: Healium's improved information design resulted in 30% fewer incorrect clicks during product discovery and prescription-related tasks compared to similar pharmacy websites.

results.title: Higher Perceived Trust
results.text: Healium received 26% higher trust ratings than competitor pharmacy websites with more clinical and visually dense interfaces.

results.title: Fewer Mobile Interaction Errors
results.text: Healium’s responsive design reduced missed taps, incorrect selections, and navigation reversals by 40% compared with desktop-first competitor websites tested on mobile.

piifund.headline: Web App Design for a Digital Banking Platform
piifund.lead: Digital banking design for underserved markets
piifund.about: PIIFUND is a fintech platform that brings digital banking, microloans, and insurance to users in underserved African markets. Our client request was to design a WCAG-compliant, mobile-responsive web app that works on low-speed connections and serves users with no prior experience in digital finance.
piifund.problem: The customer required complex banking, microloan, and insurance flows to be simplified for first-time digital finance consumers. The app must fulfill stringent compliance standards and function well on older devices with shaky connectivity. Our RZQ team also had to strike a balance between step-by-step instructions for low-literacy users and efficiency for more experienced ones.
piifund.solution: We developed an interface in accordance with WCAG accessibility standards and simplified financial transactions. The most well-thought-out solution was the microloan application algorithm. Instead of a single confirmation button, the design guides users through a detailed description of repayment terms, payment deadlines, and interest rates, and then finalizes the approval with a “swipe to confirm” interaction.

sections.title: App Flow
sections.text: Our UX/UI team mapped the onboarding flow to keep each step single-focused and free of unnecessary decisions for first-time users. Every screen reduces cognitive load. We added clear input labels, explicit back navigation, and inline compliance steps that meet regulatory requirements without interrupting the user's path forward.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: The wireframes explain the logic of phone verification and account setup, payment flows, transaction history, and multi-recipient transfer confirmation. Each wireframe prioritized single-action screens, explicit confirmation steps for high-risk operations, and a persistent sidebar navigation.

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: The web interface features a card-based layout with a clear visual hierarchy, subtle color accents to highlight balances and key actions, and intuitive navigation. Users with varying levels of digital experience are provided with a predictable workflow for banking, payment, and financial functions. We simplified the KYC process by transforming it into a minimal, step-by-step verification sequence that collects only the information required by compliance regulations. This approach reduces the number of drop-offs at the most common exit point for new users.

sections.title: Our fintech design handles complexity, passes compliance, and converts first-time users.
Mobile App
sections.text: Our primary focus was on mobile experience in low-connectivity areas. We created high-contrast UI elements to ensure legibility on low-resolution screens. Single-column layouts eliminate scrolling and minimize input errors on small screens. Lightweight interface patterns load reliably over slower connections. Every high-stakes action requires clear user consent.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: PIIFUND’s visual content on social media allows users to immediately assess financial value. Striking typography and concrete metrics replace abstract claims with direct evidence. A dark gradient background with soft blue accents maintains a consistent brand style across all formats. Each banner contains a single message. One number. One benefit. One clear call to action.

results.title: Fewer user errors
results.text: Simpler processes, a clearer hierarchy, and well-designed verification workflows have helped minimize the number of errors when performing critical actions.

results.title: Faster onboarding
results.text: flow A clearer KYC structure helped users move through verification faster while still keeping the process understandable and compliant.

results.title: Task completion rate
results.text: According to user testing, the majority of participants were able to accomplish essential banking operations such as account review, transfers, payments, and loan-related processes without requiring external assistance.

results.title: Mobile Usability
results.text: Score Participants were able to perform key actions seamlessly on mobile devices, confirming the project’s goal of providing a responsive user experience for users across different devices and under various connection conditions.

mediflow.headline: Mobile App and Dashboard Design for a Healthcare Platform
mediflow.lead: One design system for two different care experiences
mediflow.about: MediFlow is a digital healthcare platform that connects patients and healthcare providers through one integrated ecosystem. RZQ had to combine a patient mobile app with a dedicated provider dashboard. Two fundamentally different experiences live inside a single, cohesive product.
mediflow.problem: Designing a unified healthcare ecosystem for two opposite user groups was the core challenge. Patients needed a simple interface for managing appointments and health data without overload. Providers needed a dense but fast dashboard for reviewing patient summaries, monitoring trends, and prioritizing data during clinical decisions.
mediflow.solution: The patient app has clear navigation and simplified health information. The provider dashboard organizes patient metrics, appointment schedules, and trend visualizations into a structured hierarchy for faster decision-making. We delivered a shared design system that connects both products as one ecosystem but adapts to each audience's distinct workflow.

sections.title: Moodboard
sections.text: We used soft neutral tones, subtle accent colors, and rounded forms for the patient app's moodboard to create a sense of reassurance. The provider dashboard has structured grids and data-focused typography to support precision. Our team took references from modern healthcare platforms, wellness apps, and clinical dashboards to define a visual language that is approachable for patients and credible for healthcare professionals.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: Wireframing for the mobile app focused on making everyday interactions simple. Appointment management, health tracking, and access to key information have to be easy and accessible. For the provider dashboard, we explored multiple layout options to find the most efficient structure for reviewing patient data, monitoring trends, and prioritizing clinical tasks.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: The MediFlow logo uses three rounded bars arranged to resemble pills. Our approach makes the app's healthcare purpose recognizable at a glance. The same mark functions as the app icon, set against a lime-green background that stands out on a crowded home screen, so even before opening the app, users know what MediFlow is for.

sections.title: RZQ builds one design system that serves patient simplicity and provider speed at once.
Web Application Design
sections.text: Our UI/UX designers surfaced risk level and trend direction together, ahead of the detailed chart, to shorten the time a provider needs to assess a patient's status and decide on next steps. Our solution supports the dashboard's goal of fast and organized decision support. The provider dashboard surfaces a patient's vitals as trend cards with week-over-week change. Doctors can see the direction of a patient's condition before opening any detailed view.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: The social media assets combine short, direct headlines with visuals from the patient app. We created product features as individual story-format pieces. Each template keeps MediFlow's interface human, relaxing, welcoming, and trustworthy. The same screens that patients use in the app serve as the proof for the headline.

results.title: Positive Clarity Feedback
results.text: 91% of usability test participants said the patient app made health tracking, appointments, and consultation access clear and understandable.

results.title: Usability Score
results.text: The patient app prototype reached an 84 SUS score, showing above-average usability for core healthcare tasks.

results.title: Lower Cognitive Load for Providers
results.text: Healthcare professionals reported a 29% reduction in their effort when reviewing patient summaries and data compared to competitors’ dashboards, where key clinical data is often spread across multiple windows.

results.title: Fewer Steps to Book a Visit
results.text: The process of scheduling a patient’s appointment required 30% fewer steps than in similar healthcare apps. Users move from selecting a doctor to confirming an appointment with less difficulty.

cognify.headline: Web App Design for an AI Cognitive Health Platform
cognify.about: Cognify lets knowledge workers track their mental state by translating complex biometric changes into actionable insights, giving them early warnings of stress, before fatigue sets in. Neurolane Labs partnered with RZQ to design the high-fi web app experience .
cognify.problem: Cognitive health systems have many charts and technical metrics that can be hard to understand. Cognify had to simplify complicated biometric data into understandable insights. Users needed a quick read on their status and the ability to act without decoding raw data.
cognify.solution: Our RZQ designers prioritized making health data easy to grasp while highlighting the most important insights. For each AI recommendation, we broke the data down into secondary perspectives and provided an explanation. In seconds, users could grasp the situation and choose their next move.
cognify.processIntro: The process started with competitor research and product discovery. Then we mapped user journeys, organized the flow of information, and used wireframes to test the logic of the dashboard before going on to visual concepts and UI design.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: Here, information hierarchy was key. Quick decision-making was our focus as we streamlined dashboard interactions, made important information our top priority, and eliminated unnecessary complexity.

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: Our main design principle for Cognify: give users an answer before showing them the data behind it. To ensure that Health Score, stress trends, scan findings, and recommendations do not distract from one another, the RZQ team constructed the screen from multiple focused zones. An additional layer of deeper biomarker data ensures that the dashboard remains informative without becoming overloaded.

sections.title: Create healthcare products that reduce mental load and improve focus .
Mobile Version
sections.text: The goal was to allow users to quickly check in while on the go or in between meetings. We transformed the dashboard into a clear vertical flow and gave top priority to the most urgent insights. It's easier to use when you don't have a lot of time because the touch targets are bigger, the content blocks are shorter, and the scan states are simpler.

sections.title: Instagram Layouts
sections.text: Social visuals had to carry the same product logic. Using Cognify's dark interface language, our designers were able to simplify its complicated cognitive features into concise, easy-to-understand posts that maintained the platform's scientific integrity.

results.title: TIME TO COMPREHEND
results.text: Average time needed to understand the current cognitive state dropped from 14 seconds to 2.4 seconds.

results.title: WEEK-4 ACTIVE USAGE
results.text: Users continued engaging with Cognify four weeks after onboarding, showing strong long-term adoption.

results.title: DECISION CLARITY RATE
results.text: Most users reported knowing whether to continue working or take a break without additional analysis.

results.title: BREAK PROMPT RESPONSE RATE
results.text: Contextual prompts led to action when Cognify detected elevated stress or cognitive load.

braix.headline: Website Design for a Neurotechnology Product
braix.lead: Landing page design that builds product credibility
braix.about: BRAIX is a wearable neurotechnology AI product that reads real-time neural activity and surfaces that data as human-readable feedback through smart glasses and a companion digital platform. The request was to design a conversion-focused website that explains the product's benefits and value.
braix.problem: A common problem with health tech websites is high bounce rates and low conversion rates among non-specialist audiences. So, the BRAIX website should communicate scientific credibility and product innovation. Our UI/UX experts had to design the experience simply enough to drive demo requests, scroll depth, and first-session engagement from a general consumer audience.
braix.solution: We structured the website around progressive product storytelling to support longer session times and reduce bounce rates. Our designer replaced dark interface patterns common across wearable AI platforms with lighter, neural-inspired visuals and spacious layouts. Our solutions increase scroll depth and build purchase intent to drive demo and waitlist conversions.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: A logo for a wearable neurotechnology product needs to signal technological precision and cognitive clarity. Our brand designer aimed to avoid sci-fi cliches and separate the brand from the dark aesthetics dominant in the cognitive tracking market. The BRAIX mark references neural connectivity and device intelligence. It has a clean wordmark and an airy visual system built on sky-blue tones.

sections.title: Design your health tech website with RZQ to increase conversion and product clarity.
Landing Page Layouts
sections.text: This healthtech landing page features a full-bleed hero image, large-scale typography, a visual of a wearable AI gadget, and a real-time cognitive load user interface module. Our approach provides first-time visitors with immediate product context without requiring a deep scroll, which directly reduces early exit rates. Annotated neural diagrams that represent brain activity, stress reaction, neural circuits, and cognitive load take the place of clinical dashboard patterns and are accompanied by story-driven data visualization. As a result, non-specialist visitors interact with and click the conversion CTA.

sections.title: Social Materials
sections.text: Our team extended BRAIX’s visual identity to social media using a content system based on the same design as the website. A visitor who clicks from an Instagram post to a landing page sees a consistent brand. This approach builds trust and reduces bounce rates. To stop the scroll, each template delivers a single cognitive tracking feature or product detail per frame. People don't need to capture context to understand the message.

sections.title: Mobile Version
sections.text: The mobile version of the site should function independently of the desktop version and feature a reorganized content hierarchy. Our team has adapted the screens of the BRAIX mobile version so that the most important information for conversion is displayed first. The main slogan, a value proposition, and the primary call to action must be accessible within the first two scrolls. We condensed sections with neural diagrams and lists of technical specifications into vertically arranged modules that are easy to view with a thumb, while maintaining visual integrity.

results.title: Product comprehension rate
results.text: Simplified neural visuals and progressive storytelling helped first-time visitors correctly identify the BRAIX value proposition without additional explanation during user testing.

results.title: Perceived product credibility rating
results.text: Light, neural-inspired visuals and premium layout decisions produced a strong first-impression credibility score among user testing participants evaluating the healthtech product website.

results.title: Bounce rate reduction
results.text: Clear hero messaging and immediate product context delivered above the fold reduced the early exit among non-specialist visitors unfamiliar with cognitive tracking products.

results.title: Increase in CTA visibility
results.text: Strategic CTA placement across three key scroll points multiplied conversion touchpoints compared to the single-CTA structure common in neurotechnology competitor websites.

sellution.headline: Dashboard Design for a Healthcare Monitoring Platform
sellution.lead: Flexible interface for a data-heavy health product
sellution.about: Sellution is a healthcare monitoring platform that tracks vitals like heart rate, blood pressure, HRV, and glucose in one place. RZQ designed the dashboard to present scattered clinical data as a clear daily overview, plus medication reminders and appointment tracking.
sellution.problem: The aim was to arrange a large amount of medical data while maintaining a rigorous hierarchy between critical and secondary criteria. The most difficult thing was striking a balance between two opposing factors: a conservative sector that requires trust and a visually appealing product.
sellution.solution: We built the dashboard to be modular, with a scalable component library. As a result, users can add new metrics and functionality without affecting the structure. Progress indicators, status labels, and reference ranges provide quick context for the numbers. 3D visualizations of anatomical models replace abstract diagrams, allowing people to visualize the structure of their bodies better.

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: Every design decision addressed patients who need to know their health right away, and a company that grows via retention and trust. To reduce cognitive load, we used a user-centered design approach with a clear typographic scale, appropriate spacing, and high-contrast color. The idea was to encourage users to return to the dashboard out of habit. 3D elements with clear information provide Sellution a distinct identity that promotes brand recall and higher conversion rates than more clinical competitors.

sections.title: RZQ designs healthtech products that drive daily use and retention.
Mobile Version
sections.text: Most patients use Sellution on mobile devices. Every interaction happens in one hand and under a few seconds of attention. That's why we prioritized the screens users open most. The dashboard adapts to smaller viewports, summary cards stack vertically, and 3D visuals scale down without losing anatomical detail. The system stays responsive across screen sizes, and the experience feels native whether users check their heart rate during a workout or review lab results at home.

results.title: 30-day retention rate
results.text: Reduced cognitive load and a habit-friendly dashboard turn first-time use into a daily routine and support long-term engagement.

results.title: Time to interpret key health metrics
results.text: Progress indicators, status labels, and reference ranges replace raw numbers, so users understand their condition without a medical context.

results.title: Average time to find primary vitals on the dashboard
results.text: The structure-first wireframing approach placed high-priority metrics in the user's first line of sight from the start.

results.title: Reusable components in the design system
results.text: A flexible component library scales with new metrics, features, and user scenarios without breaking the overall structure.

cinex.headline: Medical Dashboard Design for High-Pressure Workflows
cinex.lead: Design for faster action in critical patient care
cinex.about: Cinex is a healthtech product for clinics and private practitioners who deal with patient data daily. The client needed an interface that works under limited time, constant context switching, and high responsibility for every decision. Our approach centered on one principle: the current patient state should become the clearest thing on the screen before users read any secondary data.
cinex.problem: The most challenging aspect was eliminating any factors that slowed down the reading while maintaining an interface that was trustworthy enough for a medical application. Within seconds, the dashboard has to simplify patient data with a clear priority mechanism.
cinex.solution: We centered the screen's design on the primary trend graph to display the initial read before the doctor evaluates any other data. Each card got one role, and we kept the visit history table format since doctors can scan the rows far more quickly than with any of the other layouts we tried.
cinex.processIntro: Our team went through the entire design process. We started with competitor research and information architecture. Then we created wireframes to establish the hierarchy. After that, we developed UI concepts, layouts, and completed a UI kit.

sections.title: UI Layouts
sections.text: Cinex user interface designs have a minimalist card structure with a single, prominent section on each screen. As visual widgets are used for the “heavy lifting” of data moments, the mobile view keeps the patient profile, essential metrics, and appointment actiontogether. Gentle pops of color, rounded cards, and soft spacing create a medical-feeling interface that isn’t sterile.

sections.title: We turn patient dashboards into clear actions during critical care.
Social Media
sections.text: When it came to marketing connections, social assets used the same product logic. Even on small devices, the large print made every statement legible. The graphics were still associated with Cinex without coming across as generic healthcare advertisements thanks to patient pictures, soft gradients, and cropped dashboard fragments.

results.title: faster PATIENT STATE RECOGNITION
results.text: Doctors identified the current patient condition faster after the dashboard shifted from equal-weight metrics to one dominant clinical signal and contextual secondary data.

results.title: DAILY DASHBOARD ENGAGEMENT
results.text: Clinicians returned to the dashboard more frequently after key actions, patient overview, and scheduling became accessible from one uninterrupted workflow.

results.title: APPOINTMENT FLOW COMPLETION
results.text: Patients and clinic staff completed scheduling flows more consistently once the interface reduced navigation friction and surfaced actions earlier in the process.

results.title: METRIC INTERPRETATION ERRORS
results.text: Visual hierarchy and contextual indicators reduced moments when users can miss patient status updates or changes because they are hidden inside dense dashboard blocks.

luma.headline: Mobile App Design for a Supplement Platform
luma.lead: Healthcare UI/UX design that forms daily habits and increases retention
luma.about: Luma is a mobile app for wellness and dietary supplement selection, developed by experts in clinical nutrition, behavioral sciences, and consumer software. Luma reached out to RZQ to increase user retention, reduce decision fatigue, and make it easier to stick to daily health routines.
luma.problem: We had to replace vague emotional impressions with evidence-based recommendations for supplement use. Because even two false assumptions can undermine user trust. The second was tonal. Clinical UI signals the wrong frame for daily wellness use. But over-softening undermines the credibility that supplement guidance needs.
luma.solution: Our healthcare designers replaced the dashboard with a radial visual that shows balance in 1 sec. Users can describe emotions in plain words, and the system converts them into a clinical context. AI recommendation cards provide unambiguous next steps with context, action, and duration. And the daily plan combines supplements and tasks into one timeline.

sections.title: App Flow
sections.text: The healthcare app flow focuses on emotional check-ins. It interprets user states and recommends actions. Luma guides users step by step and only displays relevant information. Tired users don't have to read several metrics or navigate complicated menus. Every flow terminates with a specific next step (consider a supplement, a habit, or a simple action such as rest or hydration). The "For You" feed provides timely suggestions without requiring a search or setup.

sections.title: Wireframing
sections.text: The wireframes highlighted three main cycles: the morning cycle, the registration cycle, and the search cycle. At this stage, our team deliberately avoided any emotional language to test whether the structure alone could convey a sense of calm. The main goal was to define a structure that would help increase user retention, engagement, trust, and clarity.

sections.title: RZQ designs healthcare apps where daily habits help retain users and generate recurring revenue.
Mobile Version
sections.text: Our mobile app design solutions include glassmorphism, gentle gradients, and transparent layering to provide depth without adding weight. The UI feels like a friend. Whereas competitors use a lot of numbers, Luma employs language to communicate health conditions. To avoid a rushed impression, motion remains slower than the default (350-450ms). The home screen contains around 40% of the elements of a typical health data dashboard. The empty space gives a break for the fatigued user.

sections.title: Instagram Layouts
sections.text: The Instagram layouts broaden brand reach and drive top-of-funnel traffic back to the product. Sage gradient, editorial typography, and 3D supplement graphics move to a native Stories format, so the feed reads like the product. Three layouts provide distinct functions. The daily strategy increases interest in tracking. The brand register improves recognition. The discovery layer's surfaces get complemented with tactile 3D models.

results.title: Onboarding completion
results.text: The three-question emotional check-in replaces the standard health audit. Users reach a helpful state in three taps without abandoning a lengthy intake form.

results.title: Improving user retention
results.text: Sub-4-second activation, short interpretation, and no comparison or gamification layer reduce the cognitive load (the reason why users stop using services in this category after just two weeks).

results.title: Time-to-first-action
results.text: The radial representation displays the state as a form rather than numbers. Users can read their health condition and take action without having to parse a dashboard.

results.title: 7-day plan adherence
results.text: Each day starts with an interpreted state and a single recommended action instead of a large menu or different numbers, so users follow the plan without deciding what to do first.

auralis.headline: UI/UX Design for an AI Analytics Platform
auralis.lead: Design that makes AI insights explainable and trustworthy
auralis.about: Auralis is an AI-powered copilot that delivers actionable insights with intelligent analysis, licensed expert knowledge, and long-term pattern tracking. The request was to design the mobile app UI/UX and admin panel in a natural and user-centric style.
auralis.problem: The core challenge was making automated insights explainable and trustworthy. Our design team needed to build a visual system that communicates intelligence hierarchically, supports long-term pattern tracking, and balances analytical depth with minimalism.
auralis.solution: RZQ built a layered information architecture with high-level summaries first, expandable deep dives, and transparent AI reasoning at every level. The visual system separates AI-generated insights from expert-reviewed guidance. We used calm, structured design language that communicates trust.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: Our brand designer created the Auralis mark as a geometric arrow with a focal dot at the base. The upward form signals direction and decision. And the dot anchors attention on a single point of insight. The mark follows a strict grid construction, scales from app icon to full-screen placement, and strips detail to match how the product works.

sections.title: Landing Page Layouts
sections.text: A UI/UX designer built the landing page with real photography, natural tones, and open space. This solution distanced Auralis from the dark and data-heavy aesthetics typical for AI products. The page follows a single conversion path: value statement, product logic, feature proof, pricing. Each section answers one question and advances the decision.

sections.title: AI copilots often overwhelm or oversimplify. RZQ designed the one that explains and proves.
Social Materials
sections.text: Our graphic designer developed unified social assets (stories, presentation screens, and branded visuals). They have full-bleed nature photography and human silhouettes instead of the interface screenshots and abstract gradients typical of competitor products. Each format carries one message, one metric, or one visual idea for clarity and recognition.

results.title: Increase in work speed on average, according to user research.
results.text: Layered information architecture and progressive disclosure let users access key insights without navigating through unnecessary complexity.

results.title: Of users reported higher confidence in AI-generated recommendations during usability testing.
results.text: Transparent reasoning, references, and visual separation of AI insights from expert guidance build trust in automated outputs.

results.title: Decrease in onboarding drop-off rate.
results.text: Clear visual guidance and reduced cognitive load help new users reach their first meaningful insight without abandoning the flow.

results.title: Increase in feature engagement.
results.text: Progressive disclosure and explainable AI outputs encourage users to explore deeper analysis instead of staying on surface-level summaries.

rydeon.headline: Mobile App Design for a Cycling Activity Tracker
rydeon.lead: Reducing data complexity to keep users engaged and informed
rydeon.about: Rydeon is a fitness-focused digital product that helps cyclists track activity and monitor performance. Our RZQ team redesigned the mobile app for active users who need to understand their progress and stay motivated through an engaging and simple experience.
rydeon.problem: Rydeon's interface provided a large amount of cycling data without any obvious hierarchy. As a result, users disengage before beginning a ride or monitoring their progress. We had to restructure the experience. Complex performance data should be easily understandable and motivating, without losing the analytical depth that riders expect.
rydeon.solution: Our UI/UX designer rebuilt Rydeon's interface to follow a strict data structure. The top level includes key cycling metrics and progress charts. Secondary data moves to contextual levels. This strategy minimized cognitive load but maintained depth. High-contrast lime accents draw the user's attention to important tasks and performance highlights.

sections.title: Wireframes
sections.text: During wireframing, our UI/UX designer experimented with five layout variations to see which metric grouping cyclists read first and how similar data blocks should cluster to decrease visual competition. The final wireframe layout restricts each screen to three to four content sections. The secondary element does not compete with the primary metric that the user came to see.

sections.title: RZQ helps brands turn overloaded mobile interfaces into focused products that users open daily.
UI Layouts
sections.text: We applied a dark UI layout to alleviate eye fatigue and make lime accent features easily visible in any conditions. It is particularly important in bright sunlight. Card-based layouts divide each measure into self-contained pieces that have distinct active and inactive states. Users can now process performance data one group at a time instead of scanning the entire screen.

results.title: Fewer UI Elements Per Screen
results.text: Our team stripped each screen to essential components only. We removed decorative elements, redundant labels, and secondary controls that competed with core cycling data.

results.title: Target Time to First Insight
results.text: We designed each screen so that a cyclist can open the app and read their primary metric (distance, speed, or weekly trend) within four seconds.

results.title: To Start Any Key Action
results.text: Flat information architecture ensures that starting a ride, checking progress, or reviewing routes requires a single interaction from the Home screen.

results.title: Reduction in Cognitive Load
results.text: Limiting each screen to 3-4 isolated data blocks reduced the number of decisions a user makes before reaching the information they came for.

moveon.headline: Fitness app branding built for lasting habits
moveon.about: MoveOn is a fitness and wellness app that focuses on daily movement and tracking progress. The project goal was to create a brand system and app experience that motivate users to return, stay active, and build routines.
moveon.problem: A clear goal can get the first download of a fitness app. The more training becomes routine, the harder it is to retain users. MoveOn needed branding that would bring emotion into progress tracking and make the next session feel worthwhile enough to open the app again.
moveon.solution: We have looked at the moment just before the first burst of motivation disappeared. The brand design had to make the app feel unlike any other physical tracker. So we made it warmer, more visual and easier to get back into training without forcing motivation on every screen.
moveon.processIntro: Starting with audience research and visual references for a fitness app, we created the character, voice, and direction of the brand. Our team created a consistent brand identity through logo exploration, type pairing, color work, brand guidelines, layouts, and assets.

sections.title: Instagram layouts
sections.text: Instagram is often the first place where users hear about a new app. The layouts had to have the energy of the product before the download, while the brand rules kept the future posts from breaking the style.

sections.title: Our team creates brands people feel from the first tap, remember later and return to .
Print Products
sections.text: The brand also had to live offline, on a wall banner, a gym poster, or a small handout. Each of them had to be a fast read. We kept the app name, QR code, store badges, and short call to action close to the main visual, while tilted type and sports photography anchored each piece with a fitness cue.

sections.title: Photo Collection
sections.text: When every campaign features a different kind of athlete, a different light, or a different mood, you dilute your brand. This photo collection sets a strong visual bar for future shoots, product screens, social media content, and promo pieces in every brand channel.

results.title: increase in STORE CONVERSION
results.text: After updating app icon, store visuals, and clearer first-screen messaging, the share of store visitors who moved to install increased.

results.title: SOCIAL ENGAGEMENT rate
results.text: Story layouts with one message per slide increased taps, saves, and link clicks during launch campaign testing.

results.title: FASTER ASSET PRODUCTION
results.text: Brand guidelines helped the team prepare posts, banners, and promo layouts twice as fast with fewer design reviews.

results.title: QR SCAN GROWTH
results.text: Print layouts with a clearer app name, stronger CTA, and visible QR placement increased scans from offline materials.

velox.headline: Web App Design for an Airline Booking Platform
velox.lead: Search, compare, and book in a single-screen dashboard
velox.about: Velox is an airline booking platform that lets users search, compare, and book flights in a single-screen dashboard without switching tabs or pages. The request was to design a web app with a clear flow for frequent flyers and business travelers.
velox.problem: The key issue was to combine flight comparison, seat selection, and checkout on a single page. We had to avoid cognitive overload or losing context between booking steps. The interface should balance a dark theme with high readability and accessibility.
velox.solution: Our team designed the dashboard where flight search, comparison, seat selection, and checkout operate as integrated panels on a single screen. Each step doesn’t hide previous selections. Layered shadows and glow accents separate functional zones and direct attention in a left-to-right logic flow.

sections.title: Logo Concept Design
sections.text: RZQ brand designer created a Velox mark that combined an upward arrow and an aircraft silhouette. It reinforces the brand's core idea of speed and precise direction. We built the logo on the same emerald-to-dark gradient used across the dashboard, so the brand identity feels like part of the user experience.

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: Our UI/UX designer placed flight search, airline comparison, and seat selection side by side in a dashboard for fast decision-making. We show the route visually on the map with several airline options. Their prices, durations, and stopover details sit directly below for quick comparison. The seat selection panel opens in the context of a top-down aircraft view, with color-coded availability and a checkout summary, so users never leave the dashboard to complete a booking.

sections.title: RZQ specializes in high-density interface design to make it intuitive from the first session.
Mobile Version
sections.text: The mobile interface adapts the app's logic to a vertical card flow and keeps pricing and booking status visible at every step via a persistent bottom summary bar. Our graphic designer delivered a custom set of aviation-specific UI elements: seat availability indicators, flight state markers, airline badges, and interactive map pins. Each element has a functional meaning to work at a small-screen scale without text description.

sections.title: Instagram Layouts
sections.text: Our client got a set of Instagram screens that walk potential users through the Velox booking flow. They communicate a specific product value without extra context. The social media approach treats every frame as a landing page. Visuals match the product UI exactly, so users already know what the interface looks like before they download.

results.title: Task Completion Rate
results.text: Participants completed the full booking flow from flight search to checkout without navigating back or restarting any step.

results.title: System Usability Scale Score
results.text: Testers rated the single-screen dashboard layout as highly intuitive and easy to learn on first interaction.

results.title: Average Booking Time
results.text: Users finished the entire search-to-payment flow in under 2 minutes, compared to the 3-4 minutes on multi-page airline platforms.

results.title: Error Rate
results.text: Color-coded availability indicators and instant price updates kept misclicks and booking mistakes near zero during testing.

nonarcissai.headline: Mobile App Redesign for an AI Relationship Awareness Platform
nonarcissai.lead: Visual language for emotional safety and user trust
nonarcissai.about: NoNarcissAI helps women identify early signs of emotional manipulation through AI-driven conversation analysis. The product needed a full visual redesign without changing its core functionality. Our project won the Behance award in the UI category.
nonarcissai.problem: The old interface used a brown-and-beige palette. It felt heavy and visually flat, which was at odds with the emotional sensitivity the product needed to convey. Our team had to work within the client's strict color constraints but introduce accents to add warmth without breaking the brand's neutral identity.
nonarcissai.solution: We introduced soft gradients, pink accents, and refined hierarchy to make the interface emotionally safe without heavy insights. The standout interaction is an animated Self-Worth bubble that fills like water to reflect the user's self-esteem score. It makes a complex psychological metric immediately readable.
nonarcissai.processIntro: Challenging moment during the process: The narcissism score required two visual states (a full expressive view and a compact dashboard). And aligning both within the same visual logic took several iteration cycles before the smaller component stopped feeling disconnected.

sections.title: When your product carries emotional weight, RZQ builds the visual language that makes users feel supported.
UI Layouts
sections.text: The interface has a clear hierarchy, generous spacing, and consistent navigation. So, users can focus on personal insights rather than competing visual elements. Soft gradients and micro-interactions added depth and responsiveness without visual noise.

sections.title: Mobile Application Design
sections.text: Users check the app in a private moment, so they shouldn't have to hunt for what matters. That’s why we designed generous touch areas, navigation that stays persistent, and a transition between the main score view and the dashboard summary that feels continuous. Every animation has a functional role and signals progress.

sections.title: Illustrations
sections.text: The narcissism score bubble shifts through four calm color states and communicates risk level without triggering an alarm. Users processing an abusive relationship don't need aggressive visuals amplifying that stress. So, emoji, indicators, background, and soft progress bars create a feeling of a safe digital space.

results.title: Increase in average session duration.
results.text: A clearer hierarchy and the animated elements give users more reason to explore and drive deeper engagement with relationship insights.

results.title: Improvement in feature engagement.
results.text: Redesigned navigation and consistent visual language lowered the barrier to features and case tracking that users previously overlooked.

results.title: Average user satisfaction score.
results.text: The redesigned interface matched the emotional sensitivity of the product's purpose and the expectations of its audience.

results.title: Drop in early-session exits.
results.text: Reduced visual noise and emotionally charged color states kept users in the app through content that, by nature, is uncomfortable to confront.

flowfunds.headline: End-to-End Product Design for a Fintech Platform
flowfunds.lead: The design behind 90% user satisfaction in digital banking
flowfunds.about: FlowFunds is a fintech platform that combines personal finance management, digital banking, and investment tools. It serves individual users and businesses. The client needed a complete digital ecosystem: a landing page, a web platform, and a mobile app built as one coherent product.
flowfunds.problem: Their brand felt inconsistent across touchpoints and didn’t signal the reliability fintech users expect. We had to create a unified yet flexible design system for web, mobile, and offline presence. Also, our task was to design clear interactive dashboards for complex financial data.
flowfunds.solution: Our team created a cohesive design system with interactive dashboards, clear data visualization, and AI assistance for transaction searches and financial recommendations. Core actions such as card management are front and center, allowing users to top up, block, or add cards with a single tap on any device.
flowfunds.processIntro: We covered the full product cycle: from brand research, logo design, and guidelines to UX wireframes, web and mobile UI, and frontend development with backend integration.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: Social media formats have the same visual system to feel like a natural extension of the product and reinforce brand recognition. We avoided decorative filler, so each asset leads with one specific message. For example, metric, a feature, or social proof.

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: The web UI centers on a modular dashboard where complex financial data breaks into expandable sections. Users see priority information first and drill down when needed. We embedded an AI-powered assistant directly in the dashboard. People can search transactions and get financial insights without leaving the main screen.

sections.title: We help fintech teams go from inconsistent brands to products that users rate 90% easy to use.
Mobile App
sections.text: The mobile app uses touch-optimized interactions that people can complete in a few taps. Adaptive layouts and scalable components have the same visual hierarchy and navigation logic as the web platform. So, users switch between devices without relearning the interface. Our designer adjusted the typography and spacing specifically for smaller screens to keep financial data readable without reducing the available information density.

sections.title: Printed Materials
sections.text: Brochures and marketing collateral use a black-to-green gradient, logo, and type hierarchy as the digital product. The constraint was making screen-native visuals work in print without losing brand coherence. Our goal at this stage was to make offline materials immediately recognizable as part of the same product.

results.title: Registered users within the first 6 months post-launch.
results.text: A consistent brand identity across web, mobile, and print built the trust needed to convert new sign-ups.

results.title: Of surveyed users rated the platform as easy to use.
results.text: Clear visual hierarchy, touch-optimized interactions, and readable typography across all screen sizes made the difference.

results.title: New users join the platform every month.
results.text: Simplified onboarding and adaptive mobile design reduced the barrier to entry for new users.

results.title: Average session time after launch.
results.text: Modular dashboards with expandable data views kept users engaged longer without overwhelming them.

blockdb.headline: Institutional Website Redesign for a DeFi Data Provider
blockdb.about: BlockDB is a team of data engineers and quantitative specialists building enterprise-grade DeFi data infrastructure. Their request was to redesign and develop their corporate landing page for a B2B audience (quant funds, banks, AI/ML startups, and research teams).
blockdb.problem: We had to redesign their functional website to communicate enterprise focus, verified data lineage, and infrastructure-level reliability. The interface must be fast-loading, AA-accessible with minimal JavaScript, lightweight visuals, and free of crypto-style design cliches.
blockdb.solution: Our team repositioned BlockDB as an enterprise DeFi data provider by highlighting its key advantage on the first screen. We then structured the page with simple sections and next steps, and guided quant and financial teams to exploration, sample requests, or calls.
blockdb.processIntro: The client collaborates closely with us to define a structure that reflects technical depth and enterprise focus without generic messaging. With fast feedback, we moved to UI design and development to deliver an accessible landing page for B2B decisions.

sections.title: UI Layouts
sections.text: The UI follows a strict grid and clear hierarchy: core value first, then feature cards, performance metrics (<140 ms), and use cases in separate blocks. After reviewing platforms like Kaiko, Glassnode, and Bitquery, we removed crypto-style clutter and complex messaging, replacing it with a minimal, high-contrast dark interface for institutional clarity.

sections.title: Social Media
sections.text: For a B2B DeFi infrastructure company, LinkedIn and similar platforms act as trust checkpoints. Investors, partners, and clients validate credibility there. That’s why consistent visual and verbal positioning across social channels strengthens recognition, authority, and perceived reliability.

sections.title: Move from “it’s complicated” to “this makes sense” with RZQ design services.
Mobile Version
sections.text: The mobile version preserves the same hierarchy but restructures the content into a vertical flow. The goal was to make complex data explanations easy to follow on smaller screens. Optimized typography, spacing, AA-level contrast, and visible CTAs deliver fast performance and a consistent experience with the desktop version.

sections.title: Pitch Deck
sections.text: The pitch deck features large-scale screens, strong contrast, focused content blocks, and a coherent style. Each slide isolates one core message (audience, performance, data pipeline, credibility) to avoid cognitive overload and support engaging storytelling.

sections.title: Illustrations
sections.text: We created a system of geometric, data-inspired illustrations. Cubes are for structured datasets, layered panels for analytics, and light paths for real-time flow. They visually explain lineage verification and processing logic without crypto cliches.

results.title: Scroll depth across key sections.
results.text: Structured blocks for data pipeline, use cases, and performance metrics improved engagement with core product information.

results.title: Increase in qualified B2B inquiries.
results.text: Clear messaging for defined ICP (quant funds, AI teams, researchers) reduced unqualified traffic and improved lead quality.

results.title: Bounce rate.
results.text: Institutional positioning, trust signals, and fast load performance reduced early exits and improved perceived credibility.

results.title: CTA click-through rate.
results.text: Clear next-step options (Explore catalog / Request sample / Schedule call) improved decision flow.

loca-travel.headline: Brand and Marketing Design for a Travel Platform
loca-travel.lead: Building brand identity for recognition and growth
loca-travel.about: Loca Travel is a digital travel platform that connects users with curated tours, local experiences, and personalized routes. Our RZQ team designed the full brand identity that reflects the platform's core values: curiosity, movement, and freedom.
loca-travel.problem: The client entered a market where dozens of travel platforms compete on the same visual cliches (sunsets, maps, and wanderlust typography). The key challenge was to make the product feel exciting and dynamic with strong usability and clarity.
loca-travel.solution: Instead of reaching for the usual travel toolkit, we built the brand identity around a mascot, a palette nobody else in the category uses, and a friendly tone that feels more like a tip. Every marketing template carries the same visual logic: attractive, inspiring, conversion-focused.

sections.title: Logo Design
sections.text: The client wanted a mascot-driven mark. It must be playful, animal-led, and deliberately far from the category defaults of mountains, compasses, and sunrise silhouettes. Our brand designer chose a llama image for its positive character and distinct personality, which also serves as a symbol of guidance. The client liked this idea very much, so we moved forward to the next stage.

sections.title: Brand Guidelines
sections.text: Loca Travel's brand guidelines define exactly how every visual element behaves across digital and print contexts. So, the brand stays coherent whether it appears on a mobile screen, a billboard, or a social ad. Because inconsistency directly influences conversion and trust.

sections.title: When your product needs to inspire and convert, RZQ finds exactly where those two things meet.
Social Media
sections.text: The social templates mix photography, 3D elements, and bold typography across purple, lime, and black. We offered three distinct background modes that keep the feed varied but in one brand style. Each format has a clear conversion action (a destination prompt, a booking CTA, or a direct app download) to pull users toward the next step (not only to attract with an inspiring picture).

sections.title: Printing
sections.text: The outdoor formats use the same design system, so a user who sees a poster and later lands on the app gets instant visual recognition. Large-format pieces lead with a single message and pair with 3D compositions or polaroid-style photography. The brand inspires and stays playful and readable at a distance or speed.

results.title: Brand recall improvement in user testing.
results.text: A distinctive logo, color system, and ownable visual language made Loca Travel immediately recognizable against direct competitors.

results.title: Faster marketing asset production.
results.text: The ready-to-use template system for social, OOH, and digital ads eliminated repetitive design work for the marketing team.

results.title: Increase in session depth.
results.text: Emotional photography paired with structured content cards kept users exploring past the first screen.

results.title: Brand identity and UI system.
results.text: Full brand identity and UI system delivered (logo, guidelines, UI framework, and marketing materials) in a single production cycle.

reforge.headline: Mobile App Design for a gamified fitness platform
reforge.about: Reforge is a gamified fitness app where workouts translate into ranks, factions, badges, and achievements. It’s inspired by manga storytelling and game mechanics. The request was to design the mobile app for athletes and the desktop admin panel for coaches.
reforge.problem: Our team had to translate abstract game concepts (XP, ranks, attributes, etc.) into natural and clear workout flows. The additional constraint: the product logic kept evolving throughout the project, so every system required continuous adjustments and rethinking, but with UX consistency.
reforge.solution: We adapted Reforge's manga-inspired progression logic into a usable UX system. Every workout metric (reps, weight, time, distance, etc.) directly affects XP, ranks, and rewards. The admin interface allows coaches complete control over program structure without exposing athletes to its complexities.
reforge.processIntro: Designing Reforge meant thinking like a game designer first, UX designer second. Every screen decision traced back to one question: does this make the next workout feel worth doing? The most challenging part was mapping how ranks unlock, plates appear, badges are earned, and attributes connect to real physical performance.

sections.title: RZQ brings structure to complex product logic or systems, so your users can navigate without confusion.
Mobile App
sections.text: Competitor fitness apps center on data dashboards, so for Reforge, we decided to do the opposite. Create a mobile app with a motivating user experience and gamified progress feedback. Strong contrast, metallic elements, and layered pictures highlight the idea of progress. Measurement inputs connect directly to XP, ranks, and achievements. Every screen keeps the workout simple and the progress visible.

sections.title: Graphic design
sections.text: RZQ graphic designer delivered a badge system across five tiers: bronze, silver, gold, platinum, and diamond. They have metallic textures, layered depth, and strong contrast typical of manga aesthetics. These badges are core progression elements. Each one indicates a specific rank, accomplishment, or milestone in the user's training journey.

sections.title: Admin Panel
sections.text: The admin panel gives coaches full control over training process and user management. They see a clean desktop interface with modular blocks and step-by-step flows. Complex configuration stays manageable through strong hierarchy, minimal visual noise, and intuitive controls (like drag-and-drop and filtered dropdowns).

results.title: Task completion rate during usability testing.
results.text: Clear cause-and-effect flow (workout → measurement → XP → rank) reduced drop-offs across core progression screens.

results.title: Faster program creation for coaches.
results.text: Modular blocks, drag-and-drop controls, and step-by-step flows reduced the time needed to build and publish a full training program.

results.title: Retention intent in early user feedback.

sections.title: User research

sections.title: Moodboard

sections.title: Branding

sections.title: Web Application Design
sections.text: RZQ team designed the website based on the new brand identity . The layout highlights Galaxy’s core features and keeps the experience intuitive, clear, and engaging. After finalizing the design, our dev team built the site in WebFlow with fast performance and full responsiveness.

sections.title: Drive adoption and conversions with strategic
Responsive design

health-hq.headline: Mobile App Redesign for a Children's Health Tracking App
health-hq.lead: Monitoring your kid's health has now become really helpful
health-hq.about: Health HQ is a child health-tracking platform that helps parents monitor nutrition, doctor appointments, symptoms, and condition-specific data in one place. The client requested a full-scale redesign of the app and the website.
health-hq.problem: The old application had no clear structural foundation. User flows were fragmented, information was difficult to track, and the interface overwhelmed parents. The most complex challenge was untangling the meal logging flow and restructuring it into one intuitive experience, but with functional depth.
health-hq.solution: We led a full delivery from strategy to execution. Our team rebuilt the user journeys, restructured the information architecture, and added missing health-tracking components. The client got a scalable UI system that reduced cognitive load across the platform.

sections.title: UI Concept Options
sections.text: RZQ team presented three screen concepts, each built around per-child cards with health tracking. They differed in the amount of detail displayed at once. We offered compact progress bars, a tile-based card system, and a data view with inline health alerts and an AI Chat tab. The visual direction was the same, but the choice was between simplicity and depth.

sections.title: UI Layouts
sections.text: The UI now has a clear hierarchy, large spacing, and consistent navigation. Parents can log meals, water, activity, and symptoms without friction and access actionable insights without searching. Warm beige tones and subtle microinteractions replaced the clinical aesthetic of typical health tools.

sections.title: When your app touches a parent's deepest concern, RZQ builds the experience that brings clarity and trust.
Mobile Application Design
sections.text: We understand the rhythm of a parent's day, so the design is mobile-first. It has unified typography and touch-optimized interactions that surface child health data without creating anxiety. A redesigned app is supportive and engaging enough to build a daily habit around. Parents can check in, understand what matters, and move on with confidence.

gigzi.headline: Blockchain wealth management that people can actually use

gigzi.problem: Crypto wealth tools often split security, portfolio, and transfers across disconnected flows. Users could not see their full position or complete a transfer without leaving the product or second-guessing fees.
gigzi.solution: RZQ designed a single dashboard where holdings, security status, and the next money action sit on one home screen. Confirmation states show network and fee cost before commit, so first transfers finish without backtracking.

sections.title: Transfer flow

results.title: Full position
